So bjb1-18228 has no active GPU processes. **cqa1-32758** is a different story—it's running 6 processes across its 6 GPUs, each consuming between 10 and 14 GB of memory.

Looking at the other machines, **bjb2-24035** also has no GPU activity, and the PID that was flagged in the task (392694) isn't showing up in the running processes anymore, so it's either completed or been terminated. **bjb1-32546** has 5 processes spread across 5 GPUs with similar memory usage patterns.

Across all the machines I've checked, there are no actual GPU collisions happening—each GPU that's in use has exactly one process assigned to it. The machines without any GPU activity are just sitting idle, so there's nothing to fix here.

Now I need to dig into what happened to those processes that were running on bjb1-18228, bjb2-24035, and bjb2-28827. They may have completed their work or crashed, so I should check the registry to see what experiments were supposed to be running and verify whether they finished successfully or failed. I'll also double-check the nvidia-smi output on those machines and look at the process status to get the full picture.
